description: This file defines the GrainTypeResolver class, which associates grain classes with grain types in Orleans. It includes methods for deriving grain types from class types using conventions or provider-based overrides, and manages generic parameters.

classes.name: GrainTypeResolver
classes.description: Resolves and retrieves grain types for a given class type, using conventions or provider overrides, handling generic parameters accordingly.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Main method to get the grain type for a given class, checking providers first, then falling back to conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainTypeByConvention
methods.description: Derives a grain type name based on class naming conventions, removing 'Grain' suffix and handling generics.

methods.name: AddGenericParameters
methods.description: Associates generic parameters with the grain type if the class is a constructed generic type.
